company.title: Company
company.editText: The name, country and currency appear in the garage and on printed logs.
company.readText: Only the owner and administrators can change this information.
company.name: Name
company.currencyHint: Used for costs in the garage and on printed logs.
company.positionLabel: Record the GPS location of entries
company.positionHint: When someone logs work or an hour reading, the device attaches its location (with that person’s permission; they can remove it on each entry). Never continuous tracking. Tell your team before switching it on.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.text: Every plan includes unlimited users, QR labels, Excel import and export, offline mode and the AI assistant (including hour-meter reading from a photo). No commitment: cancel at any time.

status.trial: Free trial: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left (until {date}). Every feature is unlocked.
status.trialEnded: Your trial has ended: the garage is read-only. Choose a plan to keep logging work.
status.canceling: {tier} plan cancelled: it stays active until {date}.
status.pastDue: The last payment failed: update your card to avoid suspension.
status.suspended: Subscription inactive: the garage is read-only. Choose a plan to reactivate it.

billing.founderOffer: Founder pack: 30% off for life for the first 10 companies. {n, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} left.
billing.founderYou: You are one of our founding companies: 30% off for life.
billing.tooSmall: You have {count} active machines: plan too small.
billing.manageHint: Change plan or card, download invoices or cancel.
billing.moreThan: More than 50 machines? Write to us for a tailored offer.
billing.onlyOwners: Only the owner and administrators can choose or manage the subscription.
billing.thanks: Thank you! Your subscription is being activated: it takes a few seconds.
billing.secure: Secure card payment by Stripe. Invoices available at any time.

mail.intro: I would like to invite you to join “{org}” on Godet, the maintenance log for our equipment fleet. Your role: {role, select, owner {owner} admin {administrator} mechanic {mechanic} operator {operator} other {member}}.
mail.open: Open this link to accept the invitation (valid until {date}):

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.text: Upcoming due dates for your fleet, by email, as often as you choose.
